title: Circuit depth
statement: The depth of a circuit is defined recursively: an input or constant has depth $0$, and negating a circuit adds $1$ to its depth. A conjunction or disjunction of a finite list has depth $1$ plus the maximum depth in the list, taking that maximum to be $0$ when the list is empty.
